basic.title: Senior Software Engineer
basic.location: Central Luzon, Philippines | Open to Remote Opportunities
basic.summary: AI Solutions & Automation Engineer with 10+ years of experience building and deploying generative AI, LLM-powered applications, and workflow automation systems. Proven ability to translate business needs into practical AI solutions using tools like GPT-4, APIs, and automation platforms. Strong background in designing end-to-end AI-driven workflows, prompt systems, and SaaS integrations that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Experienced in working with cross-functional stakeholders, driving adoption of AI tools, and delivering measurable business impact in production environments.

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
bullets: I built an AI-powered customer support platform using a multi-agent architecture, where specialized agents handled intake, issue understanding, policy reasoning, retrieval, response generation, and escalation across chat and voice. On the ML side, I worked on retrieval, ranking, and orchestration to ensure responses were grounded and consistent with business policies. On the backend, I designed agent orchestration services and APIs that coordinated workflows across multiple tools and data sources. On the frontend, I built agent-assisted support interfaces using React for both users and human operators, including real-time suggestions and escalation flows. I also owned deployment and reliability, including model serving, monitoring, and CI/CD for rapid iteration. The system improved resolution time and reduced manual support load by automating a large portion of repetitive workflows.

I built a conversational layer on top of an existing travel marketplace to let users search listings through natural language instead of rigid filters. On the ML side, I worked on NLP and LLM components, including fine-tuning and prompt engineering to map user intent into structured queries and actions. I also implemented tool-calling for intent routing, so the system could decide when to trigger search, availability checks, or pricing services. I built semantic retrieval and ranking to ground responses in real inventory and improve relevance. On the backend, I designed orchestration services to manage conversation state and coordinate calls to search and ranking systems. On the frontend, I built conversational interfaces that integrate with existing browsing and booking flows. I also owned deployment and reliability, including low-latency serving and monitoring. The result was a more flexible and intuitive search experience that improved discovery and engagement.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: I worked on building end-to-end clinical workflows that combined ML with product systems. On the ML side, I focused on recommendation and time-series forecasting problems, like predicting patient demand and optimizing provider scheduling and matching. I built ranking systems to match patients with the right provider based on urgency, availability, and historical outcomes. I also developed forecasting models to anticipate clinic load and no-shows, which helped improve capacity planning. On the backend, I designed APIs and data pipelines that unified EHR data into real-time services for scheduling and triage. On the frontend, I built clinician and patient-facing tools using Vue that made these predictions actionable during booking and visits. I also owned deployment and reliability, including model serving, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines. One concrete impact was reducing wait times and improving provider utilization by better matching supply and demand.
